```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(1)
```

## Load and sanity-check data

```{r load}
ca_raw <- read_csv(
"C:/github/SNR_SDM/Data/processed/Central Australia.csv",
show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
rename(
sample_name = Sample_Name,
age_cal_bp  = `mean age Cal BP`
) %>%
mutate(
sample_name = str_squish(as.character(sample_name)),
age_cal_bp  = abs(as.numeric(age_cal_bp))
) %>%
filter(!is.na(sample_name), !is.na(age_cal_bp))

# Sanity checks

list(
n_rows = nrow(ca_raw),
n_unique_middens = n_distinct(ca_raw$sample_name)
)

# Check for duplicate midden names

ca_raw %>% count(sample_name, sort = TRUE)
```

If `n_rows == n_unique_middens`, each row is one midden and no collapsing is needed.

---

## Exploratory plots

### Histogram (counts)

```{r hist_counts}
ggplot(ca_raw, aes(x = age_cal_bp)) +
geom_histogram(bins = 12) +
labs(
x = "Oldest dated age per midden (Cal BP)",
y = "Number of middens"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

### Histogram + density

```{r hist_density}


p_hist_density_ca <-
  ggplot(ca_raw, aes(x = age_cal_bp)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    bins = 12,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Oldest dated age per midden (Cal BP)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey90")
  )



# print to document
p_hist_density_ca

# save to file
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "Central_Australia_hist_kde_oldest_age.png"),
  plot    = p_hist_density_ca,
  width   = 7,
  height  = 5,
  dpi     = 300
)


```

### ECDF

```{r ecdf}
ggplot(ca_raw, aes(x = age_cal_bp)) +
stat_ecdf(geom = "step", linewidth = 0.8) +
labs(
x = "Oldest dated age per midden (Cal BP)",
y = "ECDF"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Text-only statistical summary

```{r text_summary}
ages <- ca_raw$age_cal_bp
n_middens <- length(ages)

cat("\nCENTRAL AUSTRALIA MIDDENS – TEXT SUMMARY\n")
cat("-----------------------------------------\n")
cat("Number of middens:", n_middens, "\n\n")

cat("Oldest dated age per midden (Cal BP, absolute):\n")
cat("  Minimum:", min(ages), "\n")
cat("  Maximum:", max(ages), "\n")
cat("  Median :", median(ages), "\n")
cat("  IQR    :", IQR(ages), "\n\n")

# Bootstrap uncertainty

set.seed(1)
B <- 5000

boot_median <- replicate(B, median(sample(ages, replace = TRUE)))
boot_max    <- replicate(B, max(sample(ages, replace = TRUE)))

median_ci <- quantile(boot_median, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
max_ci    <- quantile(boot_max,    c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

cat("Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals:\n")
cat("  Median oldest age:\n")
cat("    2.5% :", round(median_ci[1]), "\n")
cat("    50%  :", round(median_ci[2]), "\n")
cat("    97.5%:", round(median_ci[3]), "\n\n")

cat("  Maximum oldest age:\n")
cat("    2.5% :", round(max_ci[1]), "\n")
cat("    50%  :", round(max_ci[2]), "\n")
cat("    97.5%:", round(max_ci[3]), "\n\n")

# Stability check

tolerance_bp <- 2000
step <- 5

set.seed(2)

learning <- lapply(3:n_middens, function(n) {
sims <- replicate(2000, median(sample(ages, size = n, replace = TRUE)))
c(n = n, est = mean(sims))
})

learning <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, learning))
learning$delta <- abs(learning$est - dplyr::lead(learning$est, step))

stable_n <- learning$n[learning$delta < tolerance_bp][1]

cat("Stability assessment (median oldest age):\n")
cat("  Tolerance:", tolerance_bp, "years\n")
cat("  Step size:", step, "additional middens\n")

if (!is.na(stable_n)) {
cat("  Median estimate stabilises by ~",
stable_n,
"middens (changes <", tolerance_bp,
"years thereafter)\n")
} else {
cat("  Median estimate does NOT stabilise within tolerance across available middens\n")
}
```
